items.html:
A tall left-arm fast bowler, Saurabh Netravalkar took 30 wickets in six games in the Cooch Behar Trophy in 2008-09. He was the leading wicket-taker in the Under-19 tri-nation tournament in South Africa just before the World Cup in New Zealand, with eight wickets. He has the ability to get good bounce because of his height. He is also qualifying to be an engineer.
Cricinfo Staff January 2010
